entries.title: Ghosthunter

emulation.emulator: PlayStation Classics emulator on PS5/PS4; PCSX2 for owned PS2 discs
emulation.notes: Use the PS5/PS4 classic for the official enhanced route, or PCSX2 for owned discs if you need emulator configuration control.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official PS5/PS4 enhanced PS2 classic with emulator conveniences.

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store classic is the best official version because it converts the PS2 original with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
primary.how_to_play: Buy or access Ghosthunter through the PlayStation Store/PlayStation Plus Premium classic catalog and play on PS5 or PS4.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 third-person shooter/survival action release.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but the PS4/PS5 classic adds official emulator enhancements.

all_releases.fidelity: Converted PS2 classic with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
all_releases.reason: primary: current official route with emulator enhancements.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced exclusive-content split was identified; the PS4/PS5 classic is the same PS2 game with official emulator enhancements.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a converted PS2 classic, not a remake; converted titles may play differently and may not support PS2 peripherals.
